editorial.tldr: DeepSeek priced web search for agents at /bin/bash.75 per 1,000 calls on Oct 17, making search a metered line item. A long-horizon eval paper followed on Oct 26.
editorial.whats_new: A GitHub benchmark compares 4 web search APIs for AI agents on 30 live queries, the first head-to-head comparison in this thread.
editorial.why_it_matters: Search API choice now affects agent cost and answer quality, and neither the price point nor the benchmark is independently verified yet.
editorial.take_for_builders: Run your own production queries against your current search API and one alternative, tracking cost per 1,000 calls and answer quality before switching.

status.detail: Pricing, an evaluation framework and a hands-on API benchmark have appeared, but the sources are thin and unconfirmed.
